subtopics.title: The Layers by Composition — Crust, Mantle, Core

questions.question: The master rule that runs through all three compositional layers is that with increasing depth:
options: Temperature, pressure and density all increase
Temperature rises but density falls
Pressure falls while temperature rises
All three decrease steadily

questions.question: The Moho, or Mohorovičić discontinuity, is identified because earthquake waves:
options: Stop completely at the base of the crust
Abruptly accelerate as they cross from the crust into the denser mantle rock beneath
Reverse direction at the boundary
Turn into surface waves there

questions.question: The asthenosphere, from about 100 to 250 kilometres down, is best compared to road tar on a hot afternoon because it is:
options: Fully molten and free-flowing
A layer of trapped gas
Solid rock so close to melting that it creeps plastically — which is what allows the plates to move
Colder and stiffer than the crust above it

questions.question: The inner core remains solid at 5 000 to 6 000 degrees Celsius because:
options: It contains no iron at all
It is cooled by the outer core around it
Temperatures there are actually quite low
The immense pressure of everything above squeezes the iron so hard it cannot loosen into a liquid

questions.question: Which set of properties belongs to continental crust, or sial?
options: Thick at 30–50 km, granitic, light at about 2,7 g/cm³, and immensely old
Thin at 5–10 km, basaltic, dense and young
Thin, granitic, dense and old
Thick, basaltic, light and young

questions.question: The Makhonjwa Mountains around Barberton are significant in this topic because they contain:
options: The world's youngest oceanic crust
Rocks more than three billion years old — among the most ancient surviving continental crust anywhere
An active subduction zone
The deepest borehole ever drilled

questions.question: Ocean floor is nowhere older than about 200 million years because oceanic crust is:
options: Dissolved slowly by sea water
Too thin to survive erosion
Continuously created at mid-ocean ridges and continuously consumed at subduction zones
Converted into continental crust over time

questions.question: Defined by mechanical behaviour rather than composition, a tectonic plate is a slab of:
options: Crust only
Asthenosphere only
The entire mantle plus the crust
Lithosphere — the crust plus the cold rigid uppermost mantle, about 100 km thick in total

questions.question: S-waves cannot cross the outer core because:
options: A liquid has no rigidity with which to pass on a sideways shear
They travel too fast to be recorded
The core reflects them back to the epicentre
They only exist near the surface

questions.question: The S-wave shadow zone beyond about 103 degrees from the epicentre proves that:
options: The mantle is fully molten
The outer core is liquid — the S-waves are stopped dead, not merely weakened
The crust varies in thickness
Earthquakes cannot cross the equator

questions.question: The P-wave shadow zone between roughly 103 and 143 degrees exists because P-waves are:
options: Absorbed by the inner core
Slower than S-waves
Refracted — bent — as they pass from solid mantle into liquid outer core, and the band's width fixes the depth of the core-mantle boundary
Unable to leave the crust

questions.question: Which of the following is one of the three supporting lines of evidence for a metallic core?
options: Ocean water is salty
The continents fit together like a puzzle
Volcanoes erupt basaltic lava
Iron meteorites — understood to be core fragments of shattered planetary bodies — match the composition the earth's core must have

subtopics.title: Drawing the Interior in Words — and the Exam Traps

questions.question: The fixed order recommended for describing any layer of the interior is:
options: Name, depth range, composition, physical state, one distinguishing feature
Feature, colour, age, name
Depth and temperature only
State, then name, with no depths

questions.question: Trap two warns against arguing that the inner core must be liquid because it is hottest. The correct reasoning is that:
options: The inner core is actually cold
Physical state depends on pressure as well as temperature — and at the centre, pressure wins the argument
Temperature has no effect on state
The inner core is made of gas

questions.question: Reading downward, the correct sequence of boundaries is:
options: Gutenberg, Lehmann, Moho
Lehmann, Moho, Gutenberg
Moho, Gutenberg, Lehmann
Moho, Lehmann, Gutenberg

questions.question: Which statement correctly avoids trap one and trap three at the same time?
options: The mantle is molten, and a plate is just crust
The mantle is molten, but a plate is lithosphere
The mantle is solid, and a plate is just crust
The mantle is solid rock with only the asthenosphere creeping plastically, and a plate is lithosphere — crust plus rigid upper mantle

questions.question: In the peach model, the skin, the flesh and the stone stand for:
options: Crust, mantle and core
Core, mantle and crust
Mantle, crust and core
Crust, asthenosphere and lithosphere

questions.question: The chocolate slab slumping in a hot cubbyhole is used to explain that:
options: The outer core is solid
The mantle is solid rock with one soft band near the top — the asthenosphere — whose slow slumping lets the plates drift
The crust melts in summer
Heat always turns rock to liquid

questions.question: A compass needle knows where north is because:
options: The solid inner core spins backwards
The crust is magnetic everywhere
The liquid iron and nickel of the outer core stir slowly, acting as the planet's generator
Sunlight magnetises the atmosphere

subtopics.title: The Cork Raft and the Roof Sheet

questions.question: In the farm-dam picture, the thick cork raft and the thin corrugated-iron sheet stand for:
options: Continental crust and oceanic crust
The inner and outer core
P-waves and S-waves
The mantle and the crust

questions.question: Pushed together across the dam, the iron sheet always slides under the cork raft because:
options: It is thinner and sharper
It is DENSER — nobody legislated it; the heavier one simply sinks, and that is subduction
The cork pushes harder
Iron dissolves in water

questions.question: 'The crust is the paint; the plate is the paint together with the plank it is painted on' means:
options: The plate is thinner than the crust
The crust and the plate are identical
A plate is the crust plus the rigid top slice of the mantle stuck underneath — about a hundred kilometres of solid rock in total
Plates are made only of mantle rock

questions.question: Which fact about age fits the two crust types?
options: Both types are the same age everywhere
The sea floor is billions of years old; the continents are young
Neither type ever survives a million years
Barberton's rocks exceed three billion years, while no sea floor has survived beyond about two hundred million

questions.question: In the watermelon comparison, the 'thump' and the 'listening' are:
options: Earthquakes, recorded by thousands of seismic stations across the planet
Boreholes and mine shafts
Satellites photographing the surface
Volcanoes and their eruptions

questions.question: The hand-on-a-table versus hand-in-bathwater comparison shows that:
options: Water carries sideways waves better than rock
Solids pass on a sideways shake but liquid cannot — which is why S-waves die in the outer core
P-waves cannot cross solids
Tables transmit no vibrations

questions.question: P-waves bend at the core boundary for the same reason a spear-fisher aiming straight at a fish will miss. That bending:
options: Destroys the P-waves completely
Happens only in the crust
Leaves a quiet ring on the surface whose width measures how deep the core begins
Proves the whole earth is liquid

questions.question: Which is NOT one of the three everyday clues given for a metallic core?
options: The planet averages twice the weight of its surface rocks
A compass works, and only churning liquid metal can run that magnet
Iron meteorites look like shrapnel from the cores of broken planets
The sea is deepest in the middle of the oceans
